sloka: नील नाग आभया वेण्या जघनम् गतया एकया ।नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव ॥५-१५-२५॥
transliteration: nīla nāga ābhayā veṇyā jaghanam gatayā ekayā ।nīlayā nīradāpāye vanarājyā mahīmiva ॥5-15-25॥

translations.english: She (from behind) appeared like the earth covered with a range of trees at the end of rainy season with her single long black braid touching her hips looking like a black serpent. She who deserved to be happy and had not experienced worries was burning in grief. (एकवेणी is a trait of a प्रोषितभर्तृका Sita who was forced to stay in Lanka was a प्रोषितभर्तृका नायिका.)
